house.title: Party Divisions of the House of Representatives, 1789 to Present

about: Each Congress after the election held in 1786 + 2 x its number (the 1st Congress: the elections of 1788-89). Senators were chosen by state legislatures until 1913.

senate.note: The official table lists 22 of the 26 seats by party. North Carolina and Rhode Island, with 4 seats between them, ratified the Constitution after the Congress began.
Vacancies include the seats of states that had seceded and were not yet readmitted.
